translations.idiomatic: Liu Yiren of Pengcheng said to Zhongju, "Your talent and standing are known far and near. Long illness at home may invite gossip. A purely military post would be somewhat easier on you.

sentences.zh: 仲舉曰：「吾性本疏惰，少無宦情，豈以垂老之年，求一階半級？

translations.literal: Zhongju said: "By nature I am negligent and slothful; from youth I have had little desire for office — in my declining years, would I seek half a rank or a single step?
translations.idiomatic: Zhongju said, "By nature I am negligent and slothful. From youth I have had little desire for office. In my declining years, would I seek half a rank or a single step?

sentences.zh: 所言武職，掛徐君墓樹耳。」

translations.literal: As for this military post you mention — it might as well hang on Lord Xu's tomb tree."
translations.idiomatic: As for this military post you mention — you might as well hang it on a tree at Xu Jiao's grave."

sentences.zh: 竟不起。

translations.literal: In the end he never took office.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he never took office.

sentences.zh: 終於洛陽永康裏宅。

translations.literal: He died at his residence in Yongkang Lane, Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He died at his residence in Yongkang Lane, Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 時年六十三，當世名賢，莫不傷惜之。

translations.literal: He was sixty-three; no famous worthy of the age failed to mourn him.
translations.idiomatic: He was sixty-three. No famous worthy of the age failed to mourn him.

sentences.zh: 二子，大師、行師。

translations.literal: He had two sons: Dashi and Xingshi.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: Dashi and Xingshi.

sentences.zh: 大師字君威，幼而爽悟，神情警發，標格嚴峻，人並敬憚之。

translations.literal: Dashi, styled Junwei, was quick and perceptive from childhood, alert in spirit and expression, stern in bearing; all respected and feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Dashi, styled Junwei, was quick and perceptive from childhood, alert in spirit and expression, and stern in bearing. All respected and feared him.

sentences.zh: 身長七尺五寸，風儀甚偉。

translations.literal: He stood seven feet five inches tall, with imposing presence and bearing.
translations.idiomatic: He stood seven feet five inches tall, with imposing presence and bearing.

sentences.zh: 好學，無所不窺，善綴文。

translations.literal: Fond of study, he left nothing unexplored and was skilled at literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: Fond of study, he left nothing unexplored and was skilled at literary composition.

sentences.zh: 備知前代故事，若指諸掌；

translations.literal: Thoroughly versed in precedents of former dynasties, as if counting them on his palm;
translations.idiomatic: Thoroughly versed in the precedents of former dynasties, as if they lay in the palm of his hand;

sentences.zh: 商較當世人物，皆得其精。

translations.literal: Weighing the men of the present age, he grasped each to the core.
translations.idiomatic: When weighing the men of the present age, he grasped each to the core.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，州將賀蘭寬召補主簿。

translations.literal: At coming of age the prefectural commander Helan Kuan summoned him as Chief Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: At coming of age the prefectural commander Helan Kuan summoned him as Chief Clerk.

sentences.zh: 寬當時位望，又與大師年事不侔，初見，言未及終，便改容加敬，曰：「名下故無虛士。

translations.literal: Kuan at the time held high rank and prestige and was not close to Dashi in years; at their first meeting, before he finished speaking, Kuan changed his expression and showed respect, saying: "Under a great name there truly are no empty men.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan at the time held high rank and prestige and was far from Dashi in years. At their first meeting, before Dashi finished speaking, Kuan changed his expression and showed respect, saying, "Under a great name there truly are no empty men.

sentences.zh: 今者非以相勞，自望坐嘯有托耳。」

translations.literal: Today I do not summon you merely to put you to labor — I myself hope to have someone to rely on in governing.
translations.idiomatic: Today I do not summon you merely to put you to work. I myself hope to have someone to rely on in governing.

sentences.zh: 每於私室接遇，恆盡忘年之歡。

translations.literal: Whenever they met in private, they always enjoyed the pleasure of friendship across their age gap.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever they met in private, they always enjoyed the pleasure of friendship across their age gap.

sentences.zh: 俄而以資調補左翊衛率，尋除冀州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Soon by seniority and transfer he was appointed Colonel of the Left Wing Guard, then made Administrative Clerk of the Household Section in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon by seniority and transfer he was appointed Colonel of the Left Wing Guard, then made Administrative Clerk of the Household Section in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 煬帝初，改州為郡，仍除信都司戶書佐。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Yang's reign, when prefectures were changed to commanderies, he remained as Clerk of the Household Section in Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Yang's reign, when prefectures were changed to commanderies, he remained Clerk of the Household Section in Xindu.

sentences.zh: 及大業暮年，王塗弛紊，居官者率多侵漁，皆致潤屋；

translations.literal: In the late years of the Daye era the imperial path grew lax and disorderly; those in office mostly fleeced others, all enriching their households;
translations.idiomatic: In the late years of the Daye era the imperial order grew lax and corrupt. Those in office mostly fleeced others, all enriching their households;

sentences.zh: 大師獨守清戒，無所營求，家產益致窘迫。

translations.literal: Dashi alone kept to strict integrity, sought nothing for himself, and his family property grew ever more straitened.
translations.idiomatic: Dashi alone kept to strict integrity, sought nothing for himself, and his family property grew ever more straitened.

sentences.zh: 郡丞鞠孝稜益相嘆服，曰：「後於歲寒，此言於公得之。」

translations.literal: Assistant Governor Ju Xiaoling admired him ever more and said: "Later than the cold of winter — this saying fits you well."
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Governor Ju Xiaoling admired him ever more and said, "Only after the cold of winter do we know the steadfast — that saying fits you well."

sentences.zh: 十年，遷渤海郡主簿。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to be Registrar of Bohai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to serve as Registrar of Bohai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及竇建德據有山東，被召為尚書禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Dou Jiande held Shandong, he was summoned as Vice Minister of Rites in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Dou Jiande held Shandong, he was summoned to serve as Vice Minister of Rites in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 武德三年，被遣使京師，因送同安公主，遂求和好。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wude he was sent as envoy to the capital; escorting Princess Tong'an, he sought reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Wude he was dispatched as envoy to the capital. While escorting Princess Tong'an, he sought a reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 使畢，還至絳州，而建德違約，又助世充抗王師于武牢。

translations.literal: When the mission ended he returned to Jiang Prefecture, but Jiande broke the treaty and also aided Shichong in resisting the imperial army at Wulao.
translations.idiomatic: When the mission ended he returned to Jiang Prefecture, but Jiande broke the treaty and also helped Shichong resist the imperial army at Wulao.

sentences.zh: 高祖大怒，命所在拘留其使。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu was greatly angered and ordered that wherever they were, the envoys be detained.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu was furious and ordered that the envoys be detained wherever they were found.

sentences.zh: 世充、建德尋平，遂以譴徙配西會州。

translations.literal: Shichong and Jiande were soon suppressed, and he was banished and assigned to Xi Huizhou in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong and Jiande were soon defeated, and he was banished and assigned to Xi Huizhou as punishment.

sentences.zh: 大師少時，嘗筮仕長安，遇日者姓史，因使占。

translations.literal: When Dashi was young he once divined whether he would hold office in Chang'an and met a day-selector surnamed Shi; he had him cast lots.
translations.idiomatic: When Dashi was young he once divined whether he would hold office in Chang'an and met a fortune-teller surnamed Shi, whom he asked to read his fate.

sentences.zh: 時有從兄子同、妹夫鄭師萬、河東裴寂同以宿衛簡入文資。

translations.literal: At the time his cousin's son Tong, his sister's husband Zheng Shiw, and Pei Ji of Hedong were together selected from palace guard service to enter civilian appointments.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his cousin's son Tong, his brother-in-law Zheng Shiw, and Pei Ji of Hedong had all been selected from palace guard duty for civilian posts.

sentences.zh: 各使視即日官位，及將來所至。

translations.literal: Each had the day-selector examine his immediate office and what he would reach in the future.
translations.idiomatic: Each had the fortune-teller examine his immediate office and what rank he would attain in the future.

sentences.zh: 史生曰：「裴二及李，皆當依資敘用，然裴君終致台輔。

translations.literal: The day-selector said: "Pei the second and Li will both be appointed by seniority in order, yet Lord Pei will in the end reach the highest ministerial rank.
translations.idiomatic: The fortune-teller said, "Pei the second and Li will both receive appointments according to seniority, but Lord Pei will in the end rise to the highest ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 鄭非直今歲虛歸，後歲亦當本資不敘。」

translations.literal: Zheng will not only return empty-handed this year; in later years too he will fail to gain appointment by seniority."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng will not only return empty-handed this year; in later years as well his seniority will still not qualify him for appointment."

sentences.zh: 指大師曰：「君才雖不滅趙元叔，恐賦命亦將同之。」

translations.literal: Pointing at Dashi he said: "Your talent, though not inferior to Zhao Yuanshu's, I fear your allotted fate will likewise be the same."
translations.idiomatic: Pointing at Dashi he said, "Your talent, though not inferior to Zhao Yuanshu's, I fear your allotted fate will be the same."

sentences.zh: 言子同亦無遠到。

translations.literal: He said Tong too would not rise far.
translations.idiomatic: He said that Tong too would not rise far.

sentences.zh: 時大師弟行師亦預賓貢，因問史生吉凶。

translations.literal: At the time Dashi's younger brother Xingshi was also participating in the provincial tribute examination, so he asked the day-selector about fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Dashi's younger brother Xingshi was also taking the provincial tribute examination, so he asked the fortune-teller about his fortune and misfortune.

sentences.zh: 生曰：「此郎雖非裴君之匹，亦至方伯。」

translations.literal: The selector said: "This gentleman, though not a match for Lord Pei, will also reach regional governorship."
translations.idiomatic: The fortune-teller said, "This young man, though not Lord Pei's equal, will also rise to regional governorship."

sentences.zh: 既而大師及子同、裴寂並以資補州佐。

translations.literal: Thereafter Dashi, Tong, and Pei Ji were all appointed to prefectural aide posts by seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Dashi, Tong, and Pei Ji were all appointed to prefectural aide posts according to seniority.

sentences.zh: 師萬當年差舛，明年而齊資不敘。

translations.literal: Shiw had an error in his credentials that year; the next year his seniority still did not qualify for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Shiw's credentials were flawed that year, and the next year his seniority still did not qualify him for appointment.

sentences.zh: 師萬任益州新都縣尉。

translations.literal: Shiw served as Magistrate of Xindu County in Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shiw served as Magistrate of Xindu County in Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 及武德初，裴寂任尚書左僕射、魏國公。

translations.literal: In the early Wude era Pei Ji served as Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat and Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Wude era Pei Ji served as Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat and was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 大師至是遷播，因獨笑曰：「史生之言，於茲驗矣。」

translations.literal: By then Dashi had been exiled; he laughed alone and said: "The day-selector's words are verified here."
translations.idiomatic: By then Dashi had been exiled. He laughed to himself and said, "The fortune-teller's words are verified here."

sentences.zh: 行師貞觀中曆太常寺丞、都水使者、邛州刺史，皆如史生之占。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era Xingshi successively served as Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Commissioner of Waterways, and Governor of Qiong Prefecture — all as the day-selector had foretold.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenguan era Xingshi successively served as Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Commissioner of Waterways, and Governor of Qiong Prefecture — all exactly as the fortune-teller had foretold.

sentences.zh: 大師既至會州，忽忽不樂，乃為《羈思賦》以見其事。

translations.literal: After Dashi reached Huizhou he was restless and unhappy and composed "Ode on Restraining Thoughts" to express his situation.
translations.idiomatic: After Dashi reached Huizhou he grew restless and despondent and composed the "Ode on Restraining Thoughts" to express his plight.

sentences.zh: 侍中、觀公楊恭仁時鎮涼州，見賦異之，召至河西，深相禮重，日與遊處。

translations.literal: Minister of Works and Duke of Guan Yang Gongren was at the time stationed at Liang Prefecture; reading the ode he was struck by it, summoned him to Hexi, treated him with deep respect, and joined him daily in companionship.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works and Duke of Guan Yang Gongren was then stationed at Liang Prefecture. Struck by the ode, he summoned Dashi to Hexi, treated him with deep respect, and spent each day in his company.

sentences.zh: 大師少有著述之志，常以宋、齊、梁、陳、魏、齊、周、隋南北分隔，南書謂北為「索虜」，北書指南為「島夷」。

translations.literal: From youth Dashi wished to compile histories; he often noted that during the division of North and South under Song, Qi, Liang, Chen, Wei, Qi, Zhou, and Sui, Southern histories called the North "Suolu" and Northern histories called the South "Daoyi."
translations.idiomatic: From youth Dashi had wished to compile histories. He often noted that while Song, Qi, Liang, Chen, Wei, Qi, Zhou, and Sui kept North and South divided, Southern histories called the North "barbarian captives" and Northern histories called the South "island barbarians."

sentences.zh: 又各以其本國周悉，書別國並不能備，亦往往失實。

translations.literal: Moreover each side knew its own state thoroughly but could not fully cover other states, and often got facts wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover each side knew its own realm thoroughly yet could not fully record the other, and often got the facts wrong.

sentences.zh: 常欲改正，將擬《吳越春秋》，編年以備南北。

translations.literal: He constantly wished to correct this and planned, following the model of Annals of Wu and Yue, to compile by year and complete the record of both North and South.
translations.idiomatic: He long wished to set this right and planned, following the model of the Annals of Wu and Yue, to compile by year and complete the record of both North and South.

sentences.zh: 至是無事，而恭仁家富於書籍，得恣意披覽。

translations.literal: Now with time on his hands and Gongren's household rich in books, he could browse freely.
translations.idiomatic: Now with time on his hands and Gongren's household rich in books, he was able to browse as he pleased.

sentences.zh: 宋、齊、梁、魏四代有書，自餘竟無所得。

translations.literal: For the four dynasties Song, Qi, Liang, and Wei he obtained books; for the rest he found nothing at all.
translations.idiomatic: He obtained books for the four dynasties of Song, Qi, Liang, and Wei, but for the rest he found nothing at all.

sentences.zh: 居二年，恭仁入為吏部尚書，大師復還會州。

translations.literal: After two years Gongren entered court as Minister of Personnel and Dashi returned again to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After two years Gongren entered court as Minister of Personnel, and Dashi returned again to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 武德九年，會赦，歸至京師。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Wude, when an amnesty was proclaimed, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Wude, when an amnesty was proclaimed, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射封德彝、中書令房玄齡並與大師親通，勸留不去，曰：「時屬惟新，人思自效，方事摒退，恐失行藏之道。」

translations.literal: Right Vice Minister Feng Deyi and Secretariat Director Fang Xuanling, both close to Dashi, urged him to stay and not leave, saying: "The times are newly renewed; men wish to serve. To withdraw now might miss the proper way of acting and withdrawing."
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Minister Feng Deyi and Secretariat Director Fang Xuanling, both close to Dashi, urged him to stay, saying, "The times are newly renewed and men wish to serve. To withdraw now might miss the proper way of acting and withdrawing."

sentences.zh: 大師曰：「昔唐堯在上，下有箕山之節，雖以不才，請慕其義。」

translations.literal: Dashi said: "Long ago, while Tang Yao ruled on high, below there were men who held to the integrity of Mount Ji — though I lack talent, I beg to admire that principle."
translations.idiomatic: Dashi said, "Long ago, while Emperor Yao ruled on high, below there were men who held to the integrity of Mount Ji. Though I lack talent, I beg to follow their example."

sentences.zh: 於是俶裝東歸。

translations.literal: Thereupon he packed his belongings and returned east.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he packed his belongings and returned east.

sentences.zh: 家本多書，因編緝前所修書。

translations.literal: His family had many books from the start, and he compiled and edited what he had earlier begun.
translations.idiomatic: His family had many books to begin with, and he compiled and edited the history he had begun earlier.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二年五月，終於鄭州滎陽縣野舍，時年五十九。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhenguan he died at a country lodge in Xingyang County, Zheng Prefecture, at the age of fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhenguan he died at a country lodge in Xingyang County, Zheng Prefecture, at the age of fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 既所撰未畢，以為沒齒之恨焉。

translations.literal: Since what he had compiled was unfinished, he took it as a lifelong regret.
translations.idiomatic: Because what he had compiled remained unfinished, he took it as a lifelong regret.

sentences.zh: 所制文筆詩賦，播遷及遭火，多致失落，存者十卷。

translations.literal: The prose, poetry, and rhapsodies he wrote were scattered by displacement and lost to fire; most perished, and ten scrolls survive.
translations.idiomatic: The prose, poetry, and rhapsodies he wrote were scattered by exile and lost to fire. Most perished; only ten scrolls survive.

sentences.zh: 子慶孫、正禮、利王、延壽、安世。

translations.literal: His sons: Qingsun, Zhengli, Liwang, Yanshou, and Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Qingsun, Zhengli, Liwang, Yanshou, and Anshi.

sentences.zh: 表

translations.literal: Memorial
translations.idiomatic: Memorial

sentences.zh: （並序）

translations.literal: (with preface)
translations.idiomatic: (with preface)

sentences.zh: 延壽與敬播俱在中書侍郎顏師古、給事中孔穎達下刪削。

translations.literal: Yanshou and Jing Bo both served under Vice Director of the Secretariat Yan Shigu and Attendant-in-Ordinary Kong Yingda in editing and revising.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshou and Jing Bo both served under Vice Director of the Secretariat Yan Shigu and Attendant-in-Ordinary Kong Yingda in editing and revising texts.

sentences.zh: 既家有舊本，思欲追終先志，其齊、梁、陳五代舊事所未見，因於編緝之暇，晝夜抄錄之。

translations.literal: Since his family had the old draft he wished to fulfill his father's intent; old affairs of Qi, Liang, Chen, and the Five Dynasties that he had not yet seen he copied day and night in spare moments from compiling.
translations.idiomatic: Since his family possessed the old draft, he wished to fulfill his father's intent. Old affairs of Qi, Liang, Chen, and the Five Dynasties that he had not yet seen he copied day and night in spare moments from compiling.

sentences.zh: 至五年，以內憂去職。

translations.literal: By the fifth year he left office due to bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth year he left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服闋從官蜀中，以所得者編次之。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he took office in Shu and arranged what he had collected.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he took office in Shu and arranged what he had collected.

sentences.zh: 然尚多所闕，未得及終。

translations.literal: Yet much was still missing and he could not finish.
translations.idiomatic: Yet much was still missing, and he could not bring the work to completion.

sentences.zh: 十五年，任東宮典膳丞日，右庶子、彭陽公令狐德棻又啟延壽修晉書，因茲復得勘究宋、齊、魏三代之事所未得者。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, while serving as Director of Palace Provisions for the Eastern Palace, Right Assistant to the Heir Apparent and Duke of Pengyang Linghu Defen again recommended Yanshou to compile the Jin History, and thereby he was able once more to examine matters of Song, Qi, and Wei he had not yet obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, while serving as Director of Palace Provisions for the Eastern Palace, Right Assistant to the Heir Apparent and Duke of Pengyang Linghu Defen again recommended Yanshou to compile the Jin History, and thereby he was able once more to examine matters of Song, Qi, and Wei that he had not yet obtained.

sentences.zh: 十七年，尚書右僕射褚遂良時以諫議大夫奉敕修《隋書》十志，復准敕召延壽撰錄，因此遍得披尋。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, when Right Vice Minister Chu Suiliang was charged as Remonstrating Counselor to compile the ten treatises of the Book of Sui, Yanshou was again summoned by imperial order to compile and copy, and thereby gained broad access to search the sources.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, when Right Vice Minister Chu Suiliang was charged as Remonstrating Counselor to compile the ten treatises of the Book of Sui, Yanshou was again summoned by imperial order to compile and copy, and thereby gained broad access to the sources.

sentences.zh: 時五代史既未出，延壽不敢使人抄錄，家素貧罄，又不辦雇人書寫。

translations.literal: At the time the official histories of the Five Dynasties had not yet been published; Yanshou dared not have others copy them; his family was poor, and he could not afford to hire scribes.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the official histories of the Five Dynasties had not yet been published. Yanshou dared not have others copy them; his family was poor and he could not afford to hire scribes.

sentences.zh: 至於魏、齊、周、隋、宋、齊、梁、陳正史，並手自寫，本紀依司馬遷體，以次連綴之。

translations.literal: As for the standard histories of Wei, Qi, Zhou, Sui, Song, Qi, Liang, and Chen, he copied them all by hand; basic annals followed Sima Qian's form and were linked in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: As for the standard histories of Wei, Qi, Zhou, Sui, Song, Qi, Liang, and Chen, he copied them all by hand. The basic annals followed Sima Qian's form and were linked in sequence.

sentences.zh: 又從此八代正史外，更勘雜史於正史所無者一千餘卷，皆以編入。

translations.literal: Beyond these eight dynasties' standard histories he further collated more than a thousand scrolls of miscellaneous histories containing what the standard histories lacked, and incorporated them all.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond these eight dynasties' standard histories he further collated more than a thousand scrolls of miscellaneous histories containing what the standard histories lacked, and incorporated them all.

sentences.zh: 其煩冗者，即削去之。

translations.literal: Where material was redundant he cut it away.
translations.idiomatic: Where material was redundant, he cut it away.

sentences.zh: 始末修撰，凡十六載。

translations.literal: From start to finish of compilation, sixteen years in all.
translations.idiomatic: From start to finish, the compilation took sixteen years in all.

sentences.zh: 始宋，凡八代，為《北史》、《南史》二書，合一百八十卷。

translations.literal: Beginning with Song, eight dynasties in all, he produced two works, Northern History and Southern History, together one hundred eighty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning with Song, eight dynasties in all, he produced two works, the Northern History and the Southern History, together one hundred eighty scrolls.

sentences.zh: 其《南史》先寫訖，以呈監國史、國子祭酒令狐德棻，始末蒙讀了，乖失者亦為改正，許令聞奏。

translations.literal: The Southern History was copied first and presented to Supervisor of National History and Chancellor of the Imperial University Linghu Defen, who read it through; errors were corrected and he permitted him to report to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern History was copied first and presented to Supervisor of National History and Chancellor of the Imperial University Linghu Defen, who read it through from beginning to end. Errors were corrected, and he permitted Yanshou to report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 次以《北史》咨知，亦為詳正。

translations.literal: Next the Northern History was submitted for review and likewise carefully corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Northern History was submitted for review and likewise carefully corrected.

sentences.zh: 因遍咨宰相，乃上表。

translations.literal: He then consulted the chief ministers broadly and submitted this memorial.
translations.idiomatic: He then consulted the chief ministers broadly and submitted this memorial.

sentences.zh: 表曰：

translations.literal: The memorial states:
translations.idiomatic: The memorial states:

sentences.zh: 臣延壽言：臣聞史官之立，其來已舊，執簡記言，必資良直。

translations.literal: Your subject Yanshou states: I have heard that the establishment of historiographers is of ancient origin; holding the bamboo slips and recording words requires men of integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject Yanshou states: I have heard that the office of historiographer is of ancient origin, and that holding the bamboo slips and recording words requires men of integrity.

sentences.zh: 是以《典謨》載述，唐、虞之風尤著；

translations.literal: Therefore the Canon of Documents records them, and the ethos of Tang and Yu is especially manifest;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Canon of Documents records them, and the ethos of Tang and Yu is especially manifest;

sentences.zh: 《誥誓》斯陳，殷、周之烈彌顯。

translations.literal: the Proclamations and Oaths are set forth, and the glory of Yin and Zhou appears the more clearly.
translations.idiomatic: the Proclamations and Oaths are set forth, and the glory of Yin and Zhou appears all the more clearly.

sentences.zh: 魯書有作，鹿門貽鑒於臧孫；

translations.literal: When Lu made its record, Lumen left a mirror for Zang Sun;
translations.idiomatic: When Lu made its record, Lumen left a mirror for Zang Sun;

sentences.zh: 晉乘無隱，桃園取譏于趙孟。

translations.literal: the Jin record hid nothing, and Taoyuan drew censure upon Zhao Meng.
translations.idiomatic: the Jin record hid nothing, and Taoyuan drew censure upon Zhao Meng.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋哲王經國，通賢垂範，懲誡之方，率由茲義。

translations.literal: This is how sage kings governed the realm and accomplished men handed down models — the method of warning and admonition derives from this principle.
translations.idiomatic: This is how sage kings governed the realm and accomplished men handed down models; the method of warning and admonition derives from this principle.

sentences.zh: 逮秦書既煬，周籍俱湮，子長創制，五三畢紀，條流且異，綱目咸張。

translations.literal: When Qin burned the books and Zhou archives were lost together, Sima Qian created the form; the Five Classics and Three Commentaries were all recorded, streams and categories differed yet threads and net were fully spread.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin burned the books and Zhou archives were lost together, Sima Qian created the form. The Five Classics and Three Commentaries were all recorded; streams and categories differed, yet threads and net were fully spread.

sentences.zh: 自斯以後，皆所取則。

translations.literal: From then on all took him as model.
translations.idiomatic: From then on all took him as their model.

sentences.zh: 雖左史筆削，無乏于時，微婉所傳，唯稱班、範。

translations.literal: Though Left Historians edited records without fail in their time, what was transmitted in subtle indirect style was praised only in Ban and Fan.
translations.idiomatic: Though Left Historians edited records without fail in their time, what was transmitted in subtle indirect style was praised only in Ban and Fan.

sentences.zh: 次有陳壽《國志》，亦曰名家。

translations.literal: Next there was Chen Shou's Records of the Three Kingdoms, also called a masterwork.
translations.idiomatic: Next there was Chen Shou's Records of the Three Kingdoms, also reckoned a masterwork.

sentences.zh: 並已見重前修，無俟揚榷。

translations.literal: All were already honored by earlier worthies; there is no need to appraise them afresh.
translations.idiomatic: All were already honored by earlier worthies; there is no need to appraise them afresh.

sentences.zh: 泊紫氣南浮，黃旗東徙，時更五代，年且三百。

translations.literal: When purple ether floated south and the yellow banner moved east, dynasties changed five times over nearly three hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: When purple ether floated south and the yellow banner moved east, dynasties changed five times over nearly three hundred years.

sentences.zh: 元熙以前，則總歸諸晉，著述之士，家數雖多，泛而商略，未聞盡善。

translations.literal: Before the Yuanxi era all were subsumed under Jin; writers were many in number, but broadly considered none were heard to be fully good.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Yuanxi era all were subsumed under Jin. Writers were many in number, but broadly considered, none were heard to be fully good.

sentences.zh: 太宗文皇帝神資睿聖，天縱英靈，爰動沖襟，用紆玄覽，深嗟蕪穢，大存刊勒，既懸諸日星，方傳不朽。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong the Cultured Emperor was divinely endowed with wisdom and sagacity, heaven-exalted in heroic spirit; he stirred his youthful heart and extended his deep regard, deeply lamented the overgrown corruption, greatly preserved carved editions — already hung like sun and stars, soon to transmit immortality.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong the Cultured Emperor was divinely endowed with wisdom and sagacity and heaven-exalted in heroic spirit. He stirred his youthful heart and extended his deep regard, deeply lamented the overgrown corruption, and greatly preserved carved editions — already hung like sun and stars, soon to transmit immortality.

sentences.zh: 然北朝自魏以還，南朝從宋以降，運行迭變，時俗汙隆，代有載筆，人多好事，考之篇目，史牒不少，互陳聞見，同異甚多。

translations.literal: Yet in the North from Wei onward and in the South from Song downward, fortunes turned and changed and customs rose and fell; each age had recorders and many men loved the task; examining the catalogues, historical documents are not few; each states what was heard and seen, and disagreements are many.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the North from Wei onward and in the South from Song downward, fortunes turned and changed and customs rose and fell. Each age had recorders and many men loved the task. Examining the catalogues, historical documents are not few, yet each states what was heard and seen, and disagreements are many.

sentences.zh: 而小說短書，易為湮落，脫或殘滅，求勘無所。

translations.literal: Yet small tales and short works easily sink and vanish; should any be damaged or lost, there is nowhere to seek and verify.
translations.idiomatic: Yet small tales and short works easily sink and vanish. Should any be damaged or lost, there is nowhere to seek and verify.

sentences.zh: 一則王道得喪，朝市貿遷，日失其真，晦明安取。

translations.literal: First, whether the royal way is gained or lost and courts and markets change hands — day by day truth is lost; how can clarity and obscurity be told?
translations.idiomatic: First, whether the royal way is gained or lost and courts and markets change hands — day by day truth is lost. How can clarity and obscurity be told?

sentences.zh: 二則至人高跡，達士弘規，因此無聞，可為傷歎。

translations.literal: Second, sublime men and lofty deeds, accomplished scholars and great designs — because of this go unheard; it is cause for grief.
translations.idiomatic: Second, sublime men and lofty deeds, accomplished scholars and great designs — because of this go unheard; it is cause for grief.

sentences.zh: 三則敗俗巨蠹，滔天桀惡，書法不記，孰為勸獎。

translations.literal: Third, corrupt customs and great evils, heaven-filling wickedness — if the historian's brush does not record them, who will be admonished or rewarded?
translations.idiomatic: Third, corrupt customs and great evils, heaven-filling wickedness — if the historian's brush does not record them, who will be admonished or rewarded?

sentences.zh: 臣輕生多幸，運奉千齡，從貞觀以來，屢叨史局，不揆愚固，私為修撰。

translations.literal: Your subject has lightly lived with much good fortune, meeting an age of a thousand years; from Zhenguan onward I have repeatedly served in the historiographical office; not measuring my folly and obstinacy, I privately undertook compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has lightly lived with much good fortune, meeting an age of a thousand years. From Zhenguan onward I have repeatedly served in the historiographical office. Not measuring my folly and obstinacy, I privately undertook compilation.

sentences.zh: 起魏登國元年，盡隋義寧二年，凡三代二百四十四年，兼自東魏天平元年，盡齊隆化二年，又四十四年行事，總編為本紀十二卷、列傳八十八卷，謂之《北史》；

translations.literal: From the first year of Dengguo of Wei to the second year of Yining of Sui, three dynasties totaling two hundred forty-four years; together with affairs from the first year of Tianping of Eastern Wei to the second year of Longhua of Qi, another forty-four years — compiled altogether into twelve scrolls of basic annals and eighty-eight scrolls of biographies, called Northern History;
translations.idiomatic: From the first year of Dengguo of Wei to the second year of Yining of Sui, three dynasties totaling two hundred forty-four years; together with affairs from the first year of Tianping of Eastern Wei to the second year of Longhua of Qi, another forty-four years — compiled altogether into twelve scrolls of basic annals and eighty-eight scrolls of biographies, called the Northern History;

sentences.zh: 又起宋永初元年，盡陳禎明三年，四代一百七十年，為本紀十卷、列傳七十卷，謂之《南史》。

translations.literal: Further, from the first year of Yongchu of Song to the third year of Zhenming of Chen, four dynasties one hundred seventy years — ten scrolls of basic annals and seventy scrolls of biographies, called Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: Further, from the first year of Yongchu of Song to the third year of Zhenming of Chen, four dynasties totaling one hundred seventy years — ten scrolls of basic annals and seventy scrolls of biographies, called the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 凡八代，合為二書，一百八十卷，以擬司馬遷《史記》。

translations.literal: Eight dynasties in all, combined into two works, one hundred eighty scrolls, modeled on Sima Qian's Records of the Historian.
translations.idiomatic: Eight dynasties in all, combined into two works of one hundred eighty scrolls, modeled on Sima Qian's Records of the Historian.

sentences.zh: 就此八代，而梁、陳、齊、周、隋五書，是貞觀中敕撰，以十志未奏，本猶未出。

translations.literal: Of these eight dynasties, the five histories of Liang, Chen, Qi, Zhou, and Sui were commissioned in Zhenguan; because the ten treatises had not been submitted, the main texts had not yet been issued.
translations.idiomatic: Of these eight dynasties, the five histories of Liang, Chen, Qi, Zhou, and Sui were commissioned in Zhenguan. Because the ten treatises had not yet been submitted, the main texts had not yet been issued.

sentences.zh: 然其書及志，始末是臣所修。

translations.literal: Yet their texts and treatises from beginning to end were compiled by me.
translations.idiomatic: Yet their texts and treatises from beginning to end were compiled by me.

sentences.zh: 臣既夙懷慕尚，又備得尋聞，私為抄錄，一十六年，凡所獵略，千有餘卷。

translations.literal: Your subject has long admired this work and also fully obtained access to search and hear; I privately copied for sixteen years and gathered in all more than a thousand scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has long admired this work and also fully obtained access to search and hear. I privately copied for sixteen years and gathered in all more than a thousand scrolls.

sentences.zh: 連綴改定，止資一手，故淹時序，迄今方就。

translations.literal: Linking, revising, and fixing relied on one hand alone, therefore time dragged on and only now is it complete.
translations.idiomatic: Linking, revising, and fixing relied on one hand alone, so time dragged on and only now is it complete.

sentences.zh: 唯鳩聚遣逸，以廣異聞，編次別代，共為部秩。

translations.literal: I only gathered lost and scattered material to broaden unusual knowledge, arranged by separate dynasties into shared sections.
translations.idiomatic: I only gathered lost and scattered material to broaden unusual knowledge, arranged by separate dynasties into shared sections.

sentences.zh: 除其冗長，捃其菁華。

translations.literal: Removed redundancy and gleaned the essence.
translations.idiomatic: I removed redundancy and gleaned the essence.

sentences.zh: 若文之所安，則因而不改，不敢苟以下愚，自申管見。

translations.literal: Where the original text is sound I kept it unchanged; I did not dare rashly, with my low wit, impose my own narrow view.
translations.idiomatic: Where the original text is sound I kept it unchanged. I did not dare rashly, with my low wit, impose my own narrow view.

sentences.zh: 雖則疏野，遠慚先哲，于披求所得，竊謂詳盡。

translations.literal: Crude though it is and far shamed before the ancient sages, in what I searched and obtained I venture to say it is thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Crude though it is and far shamed before the ancient sages, in what I searched and obtained I venture to say it is thorough.

sentences.zh: 其《南史》刊勒已定，《北史》勘校粗了。

translations.literal: The Southern History carving and printing is fixed; the Northern History collation is roughly finished.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern History carving and printing is fixed; the Northern History collation is roughly finished.

sentences.zh: 既撰自私門，不敢寢默，又未經聞奏，亦不敢流傳。

translations.literal: Having compiled it privately I dare not keep silent, yet it has not been reported to the throne, so I also dare not circulate it.
translations.idiomatic: Having compiled it privately I dare not keep silent, yet it has not been reported to the throne, so I also dare not circulate it.

sentences.zh: 輕用陳聞，伏深戰越。

translations.literal: I lightly venture this report; prostrate, I am deeply fearful and trembling.
translations.idiomatic: I lightly venture this report; prostrate, I am deeply fearful and trembling.

sentences.zh: 謹言。

translations.literal: Respectfully submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully submitted.
